name: Miori Haruto
source:
The protagonist’s best friend and Shizuku’s son.

He resembles his mother Shizuku in looks and is good at sports, consistently ranking near the top of his year academically. His existence constantly reminds the protagonist of what it means to be a handsome, winning type.

He has a good relationship with his mother Shizuku and respects her as a mother.
He has somewhat of a mother complex. He looks younger than his age and often brags to his friends — including his best friend Wataru — about having such an attractive and stylish mother.

On the other hand, his relationship with his father, who is often absent due to work, is not particularly good. While they haven’t reached the point of outright fighting, he harbors feelings of rebellion toward him deep down.

He has known the protagonist, Wataru (who lives next door), since before they started elementary school, and they have built a close, trusting friendship — in other words, they are best friends.

Although he is outgoing and has a wide circle of friends, he spends most of his time with Wataru, his childhood friend with whom he feels most comfortable.

Because he inherited his mother’s caring nature, he feels sympathy for Wataru, who lost both of his parents, and often acts in a big-brotherly way toward him despite being the same age.

He is a member of the soccer club, playing as a forward. He wears the ace number 10 on his back and leads the team as one of its top strikers.

(Machine Translated Description from the Eroit product page.)
